title: Boosting Methods — Stop Before the Corrections Chase Noise
key_insight: Use early stopping on held-out data, limit tree depth, and sample rows or columns. These controls make each correction less eager.
body:
## Stop Before the Corrections Chase Noise

Training error keeps falling while validation error begins rising. The new trees are now polishing accidents that do not repeat.

Use early stopping on held-out data, limit tree depth, and sample rows or columns. These controls make each correction less eager.

XGBoost and similar libraries add regularization, missing-value handling, and efficient split search, but their many settings do not replace a sound validation design.
common_mistakes: Using a large learning rate and many deep trees without validation.
Treating library defaults as a substitute for leakage-safe evaluation.
mini_exercise: Draw the situation from “Stop Before the Corrections Chase Noise” with three labeled steps, then explain what changes at each step.
real_world_usage: Boosted trees are among the strongest methods for structured tables.
